content.text: Read marker.txt in the current directory and reply with exactly its contents and nothing else.

error: Claude Usage is set to Subscription Only. Claude Opus 5.5 is paid per token outside Claude Code. Use Claude Code mode or a non-Claude model, or choose Allow Paid-Per-Token Usage in Settings → Model Routing. If the user asks to allow paid-per-token usage, call manage_amp({topic: "settings", operation: "update", parameters: {key: "claude_usage", value: "allow-paid-per-token"}}). The user must approve its confirmation dialog before the setting changes.
